{
  "name": "Quick Pork and Pepper Paprikash",
  "category": "dinner",
  "description": "A quick cashew cream stands in for sour cream in this Hungarian-style dish. Be sure to use raw, unsalted cashews to make the cream.",
  "servingSize": "4",
  "prepTime": "15 minutes",
  "cookTime": "25 minutes",
  "totalTime": "40 minutes",
  "ingredients": [
    {
      "name": "unsalted raw cashews",
      "amount": "3/4",
      "unit": "cup",
      "section": null,
      "preparation": "chopped",
      "printedAmount": "3/4"
    },
    {
      "name": "pork tenderloin",
      "amount": "1 1/4",
      "unit": "pounds",
      "section": null,
      "preparation": "cut into 1-inch pieces",
      "printedAmount": "1 1/4"
    },
    {
      "name": "salt",
      "amount": "1/2",
      "unit": "teaspoon",
      "section": null,
      "preparation": null,
      "printedAmount": "1/2"
    },
    {
      "name": "black pepper",
      "amount": "1/2",
      "unit": "teaspoon",
      "section": null,
      "preparation": null,
      "printedAmount": "1/2"
    },
    {
      "name": "extra-virgin olive oil",
      "amount": "2",
      "unit": "tablespoons",
      "section": null,
      "preparation": null,
      "printedAmount": "2"
    },
    {
      "name": "frozen pepper stir-fry blend",
      "amount": "1",
      "unit": "package (14.4 ounces)",
      "section": null,
      "preparation": null,
      "printedAmount": "1"
    },
    {
      "name": "sweet paprika",
      "amount": "2",
      "unit": "tablespoons",
      "section": null,
      "preparation": null,
      "printedAmount": "2"
    },
    {
      "name": "dried marjoram",
      "amount": "1",
      "unit": "teaspoon",
      "section": null,
      "preparation": null,
      "printedAmount": "1"
    },
    {
      "name": "Whole30-compliant tomato paste",
      "amount": "3",
      "unit": "tablespoons",
      "section": null,
      "preparation": null,
      "printedAmount": "3"
    },
    {
      "name": "Whole30-compliant chicken broth or Chicken Bone Broth (page 280)",
      "amount": "4",
      "unit": "cups",
      "section": null,
      "preparation": null,
      "printedAmount": "4"
    },
    {
      "name": "fresh parsley",
      "amount": null,
      "unit": null,
      "section": null,
      "preparation": "chopped",
      "printedAmount": null
    }
  ],
  "instructions": [
    "For cashew cream, place the cashews in a small bowl and add boiling water to cover. Cover and let stand for 15 minutes. Drain and rinse the cashews. Combine the cashews and 1/2 cup fresh water in a blender. Puree until smooth, 3 to 4 minutes.",
    "Meanwhile, season the pork with the salt and black pepper. In a Dutch oven or large pot, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat. Add the pork and cook, stirring occasionally, until the pork begins to brown, about 5 minutes. Add the pepper stir-fry, paprika, and marjoram. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until the peppers are softened, about 5 minutes. Stir in the tomato paste and cook, stirring, 1 minute. Stir in the broth and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 10 minutes. Remove from the heat. Stir in the cashew cream. Top each serving with parsley."
  ],
  "notes": null,
  "tags": ["Hungarian", "soup", "stew"],
  "source": "Soups, Stews, and Noodle Bowls"
}
